text:
sam: Quick heads up — PR #9876 is blocked on architecture review and RFC link before merge. It changes request routing and per-shard rate-limiting safety. pinging @maria @jordan for arch eyes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9876
maria: Can you paste the RFC link or a short summary? need to see tradeoffs and SLO impact.
jordan: Also, does this affect Dedicated customers' shard isolation? any backwards-compat concerns?
sam: Short summary: adds a routing policy that shards traffic by customer weight and enforces per-shard token rate limits to prevent a noisy tenant from starving others. It introduces a `max_tokens_per_shard` param and a fallback that routes to a lower-cost model when limit reached. RFC draft: https://docs.internal.redwood/infrastructure/rfcs/shard-rate-limits (WIP)
sam: Minimal config snippet:
```
routing:
  strategy: weighted_shard
  shard_count: 8
  max_tokens_per_shard: 200000 # tokens per minute
  fallback_model: redwood/fast-1b
```
aviva: Security note — please include a brief threat model in the RFC: how shard metadata is authenticated, and whether any PII could be leaked to fallback paths. Also call out KMS usage for keys.
miguel: For rollout: can we do a canary by customer cohort (5% traffic) and a quick kill switch? add metrics to monitor: error_rate, p99_latency, token_cost_per_request.
maria: Perf numbers needed before arch ack — synthetic perf + small-scale prod-ish run results. Also confirm whether KV cache behavior changes across shards.
sam: Will add threat model, KMS notes, and perf results to the RFC doc and link them in the PR. I can add a canary plan: 5% traffic -> 12h -> 25% -> 24h -> full. Kill switch via feature flag `shard_rate_limit.enabled=false`.
jordan: SGTM. Also please add a brief section on rollback criteria (delta error_rate > 0.5% or p99 latency increase > 30%).
sam: Done — pushing updates to RFC and will add one-line RFC link to the PR body so CI will gate the merge on arch ack. pinging @maria @jordan for final ack when you have time. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build passing — unit tests ok, integration tests queued.
maria: I'll review this afternoon. aiming for arch ack if perf numbers look reasonable.
jordan: I'll check the rollout and rollback sections after maria's perf pass.
aviva: thanks — please @me once threat model is in PR.
sam: Will do. Thx everyone.
